function.description: Deposit tokens into a Jupiter Lend EARN vault to start earning yield — simple lending, not collateral for borrowing (for that, use solana.lend.borrowOperate's depositAmountRaw instead). Broadcasts and returns truthful-pending: confirmation is tracked automatically, do not resubmit. Read solana.lend.rates first for the vault's assetDecimals to convert a human amount into amountRaw's raw atomic units.
function.name: solana__lend__deposit

amountRaw.description: Amount to deposit, in RAW atomic units of the asset as an integer string, never human decimals (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000") — read the asset's decimals from solana.lend.rates' assetDecimals, or from token_find, before building it.
